## Objective
Make funding cost an evidence-backed, position-aware, final accounting component for v8-next benchmark and paper paths.

## Owning authority
- D-035 funding settlement semantics.
- D-116 monetary parity.
- docs/contracts/V8_NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION_SCOPE.md §§42, 72.
- Existing funding-related work: #364 and #368.

## Change class
CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION

## Current state
v8-next can capture funding history and has isolated tests, but the economic benchmark currently passes no funding settlements into the engine and reports funding_cost as MISSING. Venue finality, late records, open-position coverage, and all-leg reconciliation are not qualified.

## Required end state
R1 — Bind every funding row to venue event time, receipt time, source mark, position interval, and instrument.
R2 — Apply each settled funding payment exactly once with explicit sign and boundary semantics.
R3 — Distinguish no exposure, unavailable history, incomplete coverage, and verified zero.
R4 — Reconcile funding in strategy, benchmark, portfolio, and venue-account views.

## Expected file / module surface
v8-next/src/v8_next/adapters/funding_history.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/adapters/settlements.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/economic_benchmark.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/app/economic.py
v8-next/tests/test_online_funding.py
v8-next/tests/test_bounded_funding_capture.py
v8-next/tests/test_funding_finality.py (new)

## Verification gates
Test duplicate/late/out-of-window records, partial coverage, position open/close boundary cases, sign conventions, restart replay, and exact reconciliation across all benchmark legs. Run against physically captured funding responses.

## Required evidence artifacts
Funding manifest and page hashes; per-position coverage receipt; settled cashflow ledger; reconciliation output; explicit MISSING/NOT_APPLICABLE evidence where qualification is impossible.

## Non-goals / forbidden scope
No forecast funding, no assumed eight-hour schedule, no zero-filling missing history, no live activation, and no retroactive mutation of prior decisions.

### Context-completeness contract

### 11. Normative Traceability
R1 — Funding is settled cashflow, not forecast rate. Authority: D-035 and README scope.
R2 — Late data cannot rewrite an old decision.
R3 — No exposure is NOT_APPLICABLE; unknown coverage is MISSING.

### 12. Existing Types / Interfaces to Reuse
Reuse FundingPage/FundingRow, capture pagination validation, SettlementLedger, account snapshots, ArtifactBinding, and existing MISSING/FUNDING_UNVERIFIED states.

### 13. Mathematical / Semantic Invariants
I1: each funding boundary is charged at most once.
I2: held interval and funding boundary ordering are explicit.
I3: verified funding drag plus all other cashflows reconciles to terminal balance.

### 14. Canonical Failure Semantics
Duplicate -> BLOCKED.
Incomplete coverage -> FUNDING_UNVERIFIED.
Unknown/no source -> MISSING.
Reconciliation failure -> EXECUTION_UNPROVEN.

### 15. Dependency Map
funding capture -> position intervals -> settlement application -> cashflow ledger -> benchmark/economic receipt.

### 16. Ambiguity / OPEN_PIN Triggers
- If an owning contract or estimand is ambiguous, STOP and open an OPEN_PIN.
- If an artifact cannot be physically produced and hashed, STOP; do not substitute it.
- If the requested behavior would open protected OOS or mint authority, STOP pending explicit governance.

### References / sources / attachments
Related: #364, #368. Current code explicitly says funding settlement is not fed to the economic engine.

### V8 guards
- [x] I will not invent a new canonical error code, ontology, or parallel interface unless an R# requirement explicitly authorizes it.
- [x] No unrelated semantic strategy change is bundled into this implementation issue.
- [x] No frozen OOS is opened unless this issue explicitly carries that authority.
- [x] If the owning contract is ambiguous, I will open/escalate an OPEN_PIN rather than invent an interpretation.
